entities.name: group of white product shelves
entities.identification: A collection of rows of white multi-tier shelves and endcap shelves displaying white-cup products inside the store.

entities.name: colorfully packaged product display
entities.identification: Blue, green, red, orange, and other colorfully packaged products densely arranged in horizontal rows on the white product shelves.

entities.name: black open-top product display cabinet
entities.identification: Two separate low, dark-colored rectangular open-top cabinets in the passage, with bars and blue-and-white packaged products inside.

entities.name: white grid-patterned suspended ceiling
entities.identification: A flat grid-patterned ceiling surface inside the store, composed of off-white panels and gray seams.

entities.name: cyan-and-white hanging sign
entities.identification: Multiple horizontal rectangular hanging signs above the shelves, cyan on top and white on the bottom.

entities.name: blue-and-white wall-side display cabinet
entities.identification: A tall wall-side cabinet on the image-left in the opening view, with a white outer frame, a cyan-and-white top edge, and a dark blue base.

entities.name: black-framed glass refrigerated display case
entities.identification: A row of tall cabinets with black-framed glass doors beside the right wall in the later part of the footage, with horizontal shelves and colorful products inside.

entities.name: store interior light gray floor
entities.identification: The flat light gray floor between the shelves and product display cabinets, appearing locally beige-gray due to the lighting.

entities.name: rear black wall
entities.identification: A large dark-colored vertical background surface behind the display fixtures, with a light-colored panel above.

entities.name: white-cup product display
entities.identification: White cup-shaped products arranged in horizontal rows on multiple white endcap shelves, with repeated red lid surfaces, lid rims, or printed patterns.

entities.name: portrait-packaged product display
entities.identification: White-background portrait packaging arranged horizontally on the rear shelves, printed with dark-haired and red-haired head designs.

entities.name: recessed rectangular light panel
entities.identification: Multiple rectangular flat-panel lights within the suspended ceiling, with dark-colored borders and emitting bright white light.
